items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: One person that he worked for in gardening and what have you was Dwight Morrow.

ctx.x: What kind of occupation was your family involved in?

Well, my dad was a sort of a caretaker, gardener and what have you. He worked for -- he used to cut grass and garden -- garden for the folks up on the hill, you know. That was his job. One person that he worked for in gardening and what have you was Dwight Morrow. You probably heard of the Morrow family from Englewood. And their daughter was Anne Morrow. She married Charles Lindbergh. And that was quite a gig there working for them, because it was a way of living, you know, means of living, and we got along very…
What did he think about them? Did he ever talk to you about the family?
